excerpt.zh: 在最近[this.solar_system.GetName]的虚境风暴事件后，[owner.GetColonistPlural]报告称在某个孤立的峡谷中发现了难以解释的神秘现象。幽灵般的蓝色身影短暂出现，似乎无法或不愿与我们的[owner.GetColonistPlural]互动，只是漫无目的地徘徊，随后消失。
excerpt.en: Following the recent Shroud Storm in [this.solar_system.GetName], [owner.GetColonistPlural] report inexplicable sightings of ethereal apparitions in an isolated canyon. These ghostly blue figures appear briefly, unable or unwilling to interact with our [owner.

texts.zh: 在最近[this.solar_system.GetName]的虚境风暴事件后，[owner.GetColonistPlural]报告称在某个孤立的峡谷中发现了难以解释的神秘现象。幽灵般的蓝色身影短暂出现，似乎无法或不愿与我们的[owner.GetColonistPlural]互动，只是漫无目的地徘徊，随后消失。
texts.en: Following the recent Shroud Storm in [this.solar_system.GetName], [owner.GetColonistPlural] report inexplicable sightings of ethereal apparitions in an isolated canyon. These ghostly blue figures appear briefly, unable or unwilling to interact with our [owner.GetColonistPlural], wandering aimlessly before dissipating.

texts.zh: 虽然这些幽灵在本质上似乎是灵能体，但我们仍无法与他们建立任何灵能交流。然而，系统检查倒是能确认他们的出现给我们的心灵感应能力带来了积极的帮助。
texts.en: While the apparitions appear to be psionic in nature, we have not been able to establish any psionic communication with these entities. However, system checks have confirmed that their presence provides passive reinforcement to our own telepathic abilities.

texts.zh: 虽然这些幽灵在本质上似乎是灵能体，但我们仍无法与这些实体建立任何数量的精神交流。然而，我们发现他们的存在是对我们心灵感应能力的被动强化。
texts.en: While the apparitions appear to be psionic in nature, we have not been able to establish any amount of mental communication with these entities. However, we have found their presence to be a passive reinforcement to our own telepathic abilities.

texts.zh: 这一非凡现象提醒我们，我们的生存中有着无形的奇迹。
texts.en: This remarkable phenomenon is providing a welcome reminder of the intangible wonders of our existence.

texts.zh: 截止目前为止，没有进一步的人身伤害或损害的报告。
texts.en: No physical harm or aggressive behavior has thus far been reported.

texts.zh: 截止目前为止，没有人身伤害或损害的报告。尽管如此，这种奇怪的现象还是令人不安地分散了人们的注意力。
texts.en: No physical harm or damage has thus far been reported. Nonetheless, the strange phenomenon is proving to be an unsettling distraction.

label.zh: 用泥土填满峡谷。死者将被埋葬。
label.en: Fill the canyon with earth. The dead will stay buried.
